---
title: "Benjamin Black - Curriculum Vitæ"
author: "Benjamin Black"
params:
  author: "Benjamin Black"
  picture: "assets/cv_portrait.jpg"
---

```{r}
#| include: false

cv_config <- yaml::read_yaml("config.yaml")

# Load the section functions and the format-neutral Markdown helpers
invisible(sapply(
  list.files("R", pattern = "\\.R$", full.names = TRUE),
  source
))

# ---- Visual theme selection (Ben Black brand) -------------------------------
# Priority: CV_THEME env var > config.yaml `theme:` > "warm". The theme is
# defined once in themes/themes.yml and handed to both outputs: a <style>
# block of --cv-* tokens for HTML, and typst/_theme.typ for the PDF.
cv_theme <- load_theme(cv_config)
write_theme_typst(cv_theme)

repo <- cv_config$cv_data_repo
branch <- cv_config$cv_data_branch

message("🚀 CV Rendering Started (theme: ", cv_theme$name, ")")
message("📡 Data Source: ", repo, " (branch: ", branch, ")")
message("📄 Fallback: Local files in ", cv_config$local_data_dir, "/ (if GitHub unavailable)")
```

```{r}
#| output: asis

# Print contents of all sections. Comment out sections you do not want to
# include. `page_break_after` only affects the PDF.
cat(
  theme_css(cv_theme),
  "::: cv-page",
  "",

  # ---- sidebar ----
  "::: cv-aside",
  cv_div("cv-picture", sprintf("![Portrait of %s](%s)", params$author, params$picture)),
  contact_section(github_repo = repo, branch = branch),
  skills_section(github_repo = repo, branch = branch),
  languages_section(github_repo = repo, branch = branch),
  disclaimer_section(text = NULL),
  ":::",
  "",

  # ---- main column ----
  "::: cv-main",
  profil_section(
    github_repo = repo,
    branch = branch,
    author = params$author,
    toolbar = toolbar_section()
  ),
  education_section(
    github_repo = repo,
    branch = branch,
    page_break_after = FALSE,
    include_sections = c("thesis", "awards")
  ),
  experience_section(
    github_repo = repo,
    branch = branch,
    page_break_after = FALSE,
    use_bullets = FALSE,
    reverse_order = FALSE,
    max_entries = cv_config$max_entries$experience
  ),
  workshop_section(
    github_repo = repo,
    branch = branch,
    page_break_after = FALSE
  ),
  awards_section(
    github_repo = repo,
    branch = branch,
    page_break_after = FALSE
  ),
  articles_section(
    github_repo = repo,
    branch = branch,
    page_break_after = FALSE,
    max_entries = cv_config$max_entries$articles
  ),
  presentations_section(
    github_repo = repo,
    branch = branch,
    page_break_after = FALSE,
    max_entries = cv_config$max_entries$presentations
  ),
  # poster_section(github_repo = repo, branch = branch),
  # packages_section(github_repo = repo, branch = branch),
  ":::",
  "",
  ":::",
  sep = "\n"
)
```
